claim: Grosser Ring (VDP Mosel) auctions in Trier each September
because: The Grosser Ring (founded 1908) held its auction in Trier every September until recently. The VDP has now moved it to spring for private collectors. The next auction, for the 2025 vintage, is set for 9 May 2027, and the venue is not yet announced. The keyed answer and the 1908 date are right.
fix: Grosser Ring (VDP Mosel) held its auction in Trier each September for decades; from 2027 it moves to May. Goldkapsel lots soar.
